zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship，并把连接器与技能合并为插件；ChatGPT 向 Plus 及以上推送日常对话版 GPT-6.2 Sol；OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源了 Shirudo。

important.title: 重要消息
items: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship：Code Review 已正式可用，PR Steward 与 Approvals 进入测试，可按仓库策略审查、修复并批准 GitHub PR，面向 Team 和 Enterprise。
连接器与技能合并为插件，Free 到 Ultra 现已开放；EFS 同日进入公开测试，可在零数据保留下检测跨请求滥用。
ChatGPT 正在 Chat 标签页向 Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 推送日常对话版 GPT-6.2 Sol。Tibo 称到账后回答质量会明显提升。
OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源 Shirudo，用 eBPF 在不停机时加上防护；官方称 Codex 生成的防护在测试中挡住了 Java4Shell。另推出 OpenWorks，资助专家免费协助美国小企业。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: OpenClaw 昨日正式发布 v2026.11.7，codex 今早发布 0.172.0。Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.3；DeepSeek Harness、Cursor 与 Grok Bot 无新的稳定更新。

sections.title: 实验室与研究
sections.body: DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 智能体改进量子线路并用 Lean 验证，聚变相关成本约降 11.8 倍。OpenAI 今早点名 GPT-6 Cyber，回指 11 月 4 日的内核漏洞研究。

sections.title: 博客与论文
sections.body: 新稿主要是 DeepMind 的量子算法文章和 OpenAI 的 Shirudo 介绍。alphaXiv 前三名较昨日无变化。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng 以及 Anthropic、Meta 官方账号近 36 小时无原创帖。alphaXiv 单页和水木正文今日未能打开。

en.lead: Today’s biggest product news: Anthropic launched Claude Ship and merged connectors and skills into plugins; ChatGPT is rolling out an everyday-conversation GPT-6.2 Sol to Plus and above; OpenAI and Cisco open-sourced Shirudo, a Linux protection runtime.

important.title: Highlights
items: Anthropic launched Claude Ship: Code Review is generally available, and PR Steward and Approvals are in beta, so Claude can review, fix, and approve GitHub pull requests under a repo policy, for Team and Enterprise.

Connectors and skills now come together as plugins, live from Free through Ultra. Enterprise Frontier Safeguards also entered public beta the same day, detecting misuse across requests while keeping zero data retention.
ChatGPT is rolling out an everyday-conversation version of GPT-6.2 Sol in the Chat tab to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Tibo said answer quality should jump once it reaches you.

OpenAI and Cisco open-sourced Shirudo, which uses eBPF to add shields without downtime; OpenAI says a Codex-generated shield blocked Java4Shell in a test. OpenWorks also launched, funding experts to help small U.S. businesses for free.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: OpenClaw formally released v2026.11.7 yesterday; Codex shipped stable 0.172.0 this morning. Hermes Agent’s stable release remains v0.23.3, and DeepSeek Harness, Cursor, and Grok Bot have no new stable updates.

sections.title: Labs and research
sections.body: DeepMind used Gemini 4 agents to improve quantum circuits and verify them in Lean, cutting a fusion-related cost by about 11.8×. OpenAI today named GPT-6 Cyber in pointing back to its November 4 Linux kernel research.

sections.title: Blogs and papers
sections.body: The main new posts are DeepMind’s quantum-algorithms article and OpenAI’s Shirudo introduction. The alphaXiv top three are unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and the official Anthropic and Meta accounts had no original posts in the past 36 hours. Individual alphaXiv pages and NewSMTH thread bodies could not be opened today, so summaries do not invent unseen details.

summary.zh: 宣布连接器与技能合并为插件，Free、Pro、Max、Ultra 现已开放，可浏览 1 万余个插件；Team 与 Enterprise 即将跟进。这是扩展方式的产品整合，不是新模型发布。
summary.en: Connectors and skills now come together as plugins, live on Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra, with more than 10,000 plugins to browse; Team and Enterprise are coming soon. This is a product consolidation, not a new model release.

summary.zh: 宣布零数据保留与 EFS 已对符合条件的企业进入公开测试，可在企业数据不被 Anthropic 或云厂商保留的前提下，检测跨多次请求的滥用。可用范围包括 Claude Platform、Bedrock 和 Google Cloud，Foundry 支持即将到来。
summary.en: Zero data retention with EFS is now in public beta for eligible businesses. It looks for misuse across many requests while neither Anthropic nor cloud providers retain the enterprise’s data. It is available on the Claude Platform, Bedrock, and Google Cloud, with Foundry support coming soon.

caption.zh: Claude 官方帖配图：EFS 公开测试（已镜像入仓）

summary.zh: 与 Cisco 一起开源 Shirudo：让智能体用动态 eBPF 防护在不停机的情况下挡住漏洞利用，从而给补丁测试和上线留出时间。长帖还把它定位为迈向可自适应防护的第一步。
summary.en: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that lets agents write dynamic eBPF controls to shield systems from exploits without downtime, giving defenders more time to test and roll out patches. The longer post also frames it as a first step toward adaptive defenses.

caption.zh: OpenAI 官方帖配图：与 Cisco 合作的 Shirudo（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Image from the official OpenAI post on Shirudo with Cisco (mirrored in-repo)

summary.zh: 今早转发 11 月 4 日的研究《A thousand fewer paths to root》，并点名 GPT-6 Cyber：在一次运行中帮助验证了 948 个可本地提权的 Linux 内核漏洞，并生成供维护者审阅的补丁。这是对已发表研究的点名，不是一篇新论文。
summary.en: This morning OpenAI pointed back to its November 4 research note “A thousand fewer paths to root,” now naming GPT-6 Cyber. In one run, the model helped validate 948 Linux kernel bugs that could grant local root and generated patches for review. This is a named recap of already published research, not a new paper.

caption.zh: OpenAI 官方帖视频截图：GPT-6 Cyber 与 Linux 内核漏洞研究（已镜像入仓）

summary.zh: 推出 OpenWorks：资助本地 AI 专家，免费帮助小企业发展所需的工具和技能。官方页面写明，这是面向美国社区的试点，合作伙伴每月津贴最高 8000 美元。
summary.en: OpenAI launched OpenWorks, which funds local AI experts to help small businesses develop tools and skills at no cost to the owners. The official page describes a U.S. community pilot, with partners eligible for a monthly stipend of up to $8,000.

summary.zh: 介绍用多组 Gemini 4 智能体改进量子线路，最高可将未来模拟成本降低约 10 倍，并用 Lean 做形式化验证，相关库和验证结果将开源。
summary.en: DeepMind said teams of Gemini 4 agents built new quantum circuits that could cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times, with the results formally verified in Lean, and that the library and verified solutions will be open-sourced.

summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon recreated Alan Turing’s 1936 study at King’s College, Cambridge, from archival photos in Antigravity, including a running Universal Turing Machine. This is a capability demo, not a new model release.

summary.en: He quoted the official ChatGPT post and said answer quality should jump once the rollout reaches you, and that together with a simpler app and the merging of chat and work, day-to-day experience should be better by year end. The quoted post says an everyday-conversation GPT-6.2 Sol is rolling out in the Chat tab to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise.

summary.en: He said that inside OpenAI, dots are quickly becoming the primary way to get things done, and that they have dots building the dots system itself. He quoted a teammate’s recap of recent dots improvements.

summary.en: New ChatGPT Business workspaces created by November 30 get double the included usage for every seat type through December 31. He also said there will be a gift for teams already on Business. This is a limited promotion, not a new model release.

title.zh: 用智能体和形式化验证寻找更快的量子算法
title.en: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification

summary.zh: 11 月 23 日，Sergey Shirobokov、Ben Jaderberg 和 Ryan Babbush 撰文介绍：他们让多组独立的 Gemini 4 智能体改进已知量子算法，并用 Lean 证明结果成立。例子包括：与惯性约束聚变相关的线路成本约降 11.8 倍，所需纠错量子比特从 5650 降到 4338；某光敏分子模拟约便宜 8 倍；对药物代谢关键酶细胞色素 P450 约改进 2.5 倍。智能体每四小时交换和辩论想法。DeepMind 将开源 Lean 库、问题说明和已验证的解。
summary.en: On November 23, Sergey Shirobokov, Ben Jaderberg, and Ryan Babbush described using separate teams of Gemini 4 agents to improve known quantum algorithms, then proving the results in Lean. Examples include an inertial-confinement-fusion circuit that cut cost by about 11.8× and reduced required error-corrected qubits from 5,650 to 4,338; an 8× cheaper simulation of a light-sensitive molecule; and a 2.5× improvement for Cytochrome P450. Agent teams met every four hours to trade and debate ideas. DeepMind is open-sourcing the Lean library, problem specifications, and verified solutions.

caption.zh: DeepMind 文章题图：用智能体改进量子算法（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Card image from DeepMind’s quantum-algorithms article (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 推出 Shirudo
title.en: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo

summary.zh: 11 月 23 日，OpenAI 与 Cisco 宣布开源 Shirudo（日语「盾」）。它用 eBPF 在运行中的 Linux 系统上施加经操作员批准的临时防护，以便在补丁测试和上线期间挡住漏洞利用，同时尽量放行正当请求。官方写道，在受控测试中，由 Codex 生成的防护成功挡住了对正在运行的 Elasticsearch 的 Java4Shell 尝试，且无需重启。OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 在文中强调，发现漏洞并不等于明天就能给每台机器打上补丁。
summary.en: On November 23, OpenAI and Cisco announced Shirudo (Japanese for “shield”) as an open-source runtime. It uses eBPF to apply operator-approved temporary shields on running Linux systems, so teams can block exploit behavior while legitimate requests continue during patch testing and rollout. OpenAI says that in a controlled test, a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit attempt against a running Elasticsearch service without a restart. President Greg Brockman is quoted saying that finding a bug today does not mean every system can be patched tomorrow.

caption.zh: OpenAI 文章题图：与 Cisco 合作推出 Shirudo（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Card image from OpenAI’s Shirudo announcement (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: 语言模型的 Harness 也可以成为可组合的泛化器
title.en: Language Model Harnesses Can Be Compositional Generalizers

summary.zh: Alex L. Zhang、Souradip Chakraborty 和 Omar Khattab 认为，标准 agent harness 会不断堆积上下文，使网络必须对长程任务做昂贵泛化。他们研究把 harness 本身训练成可组合的神经符号泛化器，从而让模型看到的每一步都更接近分布内。首页显示该文仍居前列，约 9 千次浏览。今日未能打开论文页，摘要沿用已核对的介绍，未编造新结果。
summary.en: Alex L. Zhang, Souradip Chakraborty, and Omar Khattab argue that standard agent harnesses accumulate context, forcing the network to generalize expensively on long-horizon tasks. They study training the harness itself as a compositional neuro-symbolic generalizer, so each step the model sees stays closer to the training distribution. The homepage still lists it near the top, with about 9k views. The paper page could not be opened today, so this summary follows the already checked description and does not invent new results.

caption.zh: alphaXiv 论文页题图：可组合的语言模型 Harness（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: alphaXiv card image for the compositional language-model harness paper (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: 反事实世界模型：能回答「如果」的 JEPA
title.en: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About “What If”

summary.zh: Randall Balestriero、Yann LeCun 等人讨论：在不能完全观察的环境里，世界模型如何回答「若采取另一动作、但扰动相同，结果会怎样」。他们证明，只在事实转移上训练的世界模型无法独自回答这个问题；当动作与扰动可视为可分力时，可用观测结果加上两种动作预测之差构造一阶近似。首页显示约 8 千次浏览，位次较昨日无变化。
summary.en: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun, and coauthors discuss how a world model in a partially observed environment can answer what would have happened under a different action subject to the same disturbance. They argue that a world model trained only on factual transitions cannot answer this alone; when actions and disturbances can be treated as separable forces, an observed outcome plus the difference between two action predictions can give a first-order approximation. The homepage shows about 8k views, with no change in rank versus yesterday.

caption.zh: alphaXiv 论文页题图：反事实 JEPA 世界模型（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: alphaXiv card image for the counterfactual JEPA world-model paper (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: 一份尚未被确认的黎曼猜想证明声明
title.en: A claimed, still-unconfirmed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis

summary.zh: 作者给出一份据称已经机器检查的黎曼猜想证明声明，但冗长论证仍需独立的数学审阅，不能视为已被确认。该文仍出现在 alphaXiv 首页的显著位置，位次较昨日没有变化。今日未能打开论文页，摘要只复述首页已展示的审慎表述，不对其正确性作判断。
summary.en: The author presents a claimed, machine-checked proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, but the lengthy argument still needs independent mathematical scrutiny and should not be treated as confirmed. The paper remains prominently placed on the alphaXiv homepage, with no change in rank versus yesterday. summary.en: v2026.11.7 was formally published at 09:33 Beijing time yesterday, filling in the release notes that were still missing when yesterday’s briefing only saw the tag. Highlights include recovering interrupted replies and child results across Gateway restarts; letting an automation’s owner conversation repair failures and distinguishing recovered or skipped runs from genuine failures; finishing Git and package updates; keeping chats responsive during slow filesystem work; and pairing another browser with a short code approved on the Gateway host. There are also three breaking plugin-SDK changes that need a documented migration. The experimental line moved to v2026.11.10-beta.2 yesterday. Extended-stable / LTS remains v2026.10.33.

summary.en: Stable 0.172.0 was published at 08:03 Beijing time this morning, succeeding 0.171.0 from November 20. New features include following thread links from search results and transcripts; pressing Tab to complete slash-command arguments, such as turning `/mcp lo` into `/mcp login`; jumping between task groups in the agent command center with Shift+Up/Down; setting an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in config.toml; and letting app-server clients select Amazon Bedrock Runtime during setup or sign-in. Fixes include restoring saved sandbox permissions and workspace paths for `codex exec resume`. The bundled openai-docs skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol.

summary.zh: 11 月 23 日正式推出 Claude Ship：Code Review 已正式可用，PR Steward 与 Claude Approvals 进入测试，面向 Team 和 Enterprise 的 GitHub 仓库。符合条件的 Enterprise 组织可在 2027 年 1 月 15 日前领取至少 1 万美元额度。同日，连接器与技能合并为插件，Free 到 Ultra 现已开放；EFS 也进入公开测试。Anthropic 新闻室页面置顶仍是 11 月 9 日的 Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2，上述稿件发布在 claude.com。
summary.en: On November 23 Anthropic formally introduced Claude Ship: Code Review is generally available, and PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta, for Team and Enterprise GitHub repositories. Eligible Enterprise organizations can claim at least $10,000 in credits by January 15, 2027. The same day, connectors and skills were merged into plugins, now live from Free through Ultra, and EFS entered public beta. Anthropic’s newsroom page still leads with the November 9 Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 post; these write-ups are on claude.com.

title.en: If classes are not tracked, can high performers still thrive?

summary.zh: 这是更早的旧帖，继续讨论分班与学霸成长的关系，跟帖已到 60 层，前日仍有新回复，和「阳光分班」讨论互相呼应。
summary.en: This is an older thread that continues the discussion of class assignment and how high performers grow. It now has 60 replies, including a new one the day before yesterday, and it still echoes the mixed-class debate.

title.zh: 一年级数学考两次8x，语文第一次考7x，咋办
title.en: What to do after a first grader’s 80s in math and 70s in Chinese

summary.zh: 楼主为一年级孩子数学两次 80 多分、语文首次 70 多分求助。讨论集中在要不要紧张、以及如何在家里补习。近日仍留在首页，但最新回复还停在前日。
summary.en: A parent asks what to do after a first grader scored in the 80s on two math tests and in the 70s on a first Chinese test. Replies focus on whether to worry and how to help at home. The thread is still on the first page, but the latest reply remains from the day before yesterday.

title.zh: 北京怎么没有秋假，北京秋天挺舒服的
title.en: Why doesn’t Beijing have an autumn break?

summary.zh: 楼主讨论北京为何没有秋假。近日仍留在首页，但讨论规模不大，最新回复还停在前日。
summary.en: The original poster asks why Beijing has no autumn break, given how pleasant the season is. The thread is still on the first page, but discussion remains light, and the latest reply is from the day before yesterday.

title.zh: 二三年级孩子几点能睡觉？
title.en: What bedtime is reasonable for second- and third-graders?

summary.en: A parent asks what bedtime is reasonable for second- and third-graders. Replies discuss routines and how homework load affects sleep. The thread is still on the first page, and the latest reply remains from the day before yesterday.

title.zh: 家里有个不争气的孩子，我感觉就像
title.en: A parent writes about anxiety over a child’s progress

summary.zh: 楼主表达对孩子学习状态的焦虑。讨论较多，多为家长之间的经验分享和情绪支持。近日仍留在首页，最新回复还停在前日。
summary.en: The original poster writes about anxiety over a child’s academic progress. The discussion is substantial and mostly offers fellow parents’ experiences and support. The thread is still on the first page, and the latest reply remains from the day before yesterday.

title.zh: 高知们赞成阳光分班吗
title.en: Do highly educated parents support mixed-ability class assignment?

summary.zh: 楼主发起关于「阳光分班」（均衡分班）的讨论，跟帖已超过 200 层，仍是近期最热的话题之一。近日仍留在首页，但最新回复还停在 11 月 20 日。
summary.en: The original poster asks whether highly educated parents support mixed-ability (“sunshine”) class assignment. The thread has more than 200 replies and remains one of the week’s hottest topics. It is still on the first page, but the latest reply remains from November 20.
